MGT 409 · Final project · Daria Shariff

Tidy

A cozy voxel room where the to-do list you're avoiding becomes a room you can tidy up.

github.com/dariashariff-sketch/tidy

The problem

"I found myself stressed out of my mind with a million things on my to-do list, and no will or motivation to do any of them, leading to an inevitable cycle of procrastination."

  • 80–95% of college students procrastinate (Steel, 2007)
  • About 4 in 10 workers felt a lot of stress yesterday (Gallup, 2024)
  • Procrastination is avoiding a bad feeling, not bad time management (Sirois & Pychyl, 2013)
A normal to-do list is a growing wall of unchecked boxes. It reminds you of what you haven't done, and that feeling is exactly what drives the avoidance.

← So what if we give it a good feeling?

Built on the psychology of stress

Write it downA concrete plan quiets unfinished-goal thoughts (Masicampo & Baumeister, 2011)
Small, visible winsTidying the room, XP and the Done list: the progress principle (Amabile & Kramer, 2011)
Start hereYour pet walks to a quick win, so you don't have to decide
Kind tipsA tiny first move and a note about the stress, because procrastination is mood repair
Calm by designSoft music (music lowers stress: de Witte et al., 2020), night mode, a sleeping pet
Stress toysCoins buy squishies you can squish, with a slow rise and a soft foam sound
Gentle urgencyDeadlines gather dust instead of setting off alarms
CelebrateYour pet gets the zoomies when you finish

Cuts: fixed a double call ($0.012 → $0.0066) · four agents → one Tidier call ($0.0066 → $0.0012, 8.5 s → 1.4 s) · Coach and Prioritizer only when needed · dropped the SDK (first task 20 s → 2 s). gpt-6-luna prices: $1.25 / $10 per million tokens.

Safety

  • Crisis: rules + the Tidier's check → 988, Crisis Text Line, Yale counseling
  • Prompt injection: rule screen, tagged input, Tidier label, Azure filter, code checks
  • Errors and loops: one call per job, safe fallbacks
  • Spending: 30-task cap, rate limit, daily token budget
  • Data: stays on your computer, key never reaches the browser

11 / 11 test inputs handled correctly

Next steps

  • A multi-week trial: does stress go down and do people finish more?
  • Prompt caching across agents (90% off repeated prompt tokens)
  • Mobile layout and calendar sync for deadlines
  • Gentle, opt-in reminders at times you choose

Tidy: make starting feel small, finishing feel good, and progress impossible to miss.
